task_title: cross-model run comparison: gameplay quality metrics from telemetry
task_criteria: 1) Two runs on the same segment produce a side-by-side metric table naming the models (fixture data must be explicitly labeled if real paired runs are absent). 2) Every number in the table is derivable from stored events (one damage figure traced back to its raw record). 3) The report states which partitions it read and which it excluded. Code: new src/core/battle_run_compare.py + scripts/compare_battle_runs.py + tests/test_battle_run_compare.py, store files unmodified, tests green.

items.criterion: 1) Two runs on the same segment produce a side-by-side metric table naming the models (fixture data must be explicitly labeled if real paired runs are absent). 2) Every number in the table is derivable from stored events (one damage figure traced back to its raw record). 3) The report states which partitions it read and which it excluded. Code: new src/core/battle_run_compare.py + scripts/compare_battle_runs.py + tests/test_battle_run_compare.py, store files unmodified, tests green.
items.detail: All three sub-parts verified by running the CLI against a real store built through BattleTelemetryStore. (1) Table names the models: header 'metric  deepseek-v4-flash  glm-5.3-flash' and 'COMPARISON: 20261117_090000 (deepseek-v4-flash · provider=openrouter · arm=llm)  vs  20261117_093000 (glm-5.3-flash · provider=openrouter · arm=llm)' (render_table src/core/battle_run_compare.py:1460-1475). Fixture labelling: without --note the report prints 'label: unlabeled: every number in this table comes from stored events; nothing here proves the runs were real game runs. Pass --note with the label the store actually represents (e.g. --note fixture)' (_NOT_DERIVABLE_NOTE scripts/compare_battle_runs.py:56-60); a non-comparable pair also prints DATA_GAP_REAL_PAIRED_RUNS ('real paired runs: not established by this report ... a table built over fixture events must be labelled as a fixture'). (2) Derivable from stored events: 'damage_dealt_total 15 15  # 4 / 6 records summed', and the SPOT CHECK re-reads the raw line: 'damage_dealt_total=15 includes battle-20261117_090000-ep001-enc001.jsonl:1 = 4 HP' / 'identity 5ba46dd24975…, damage=4, turn=1, side=player) → raw record MATCH' (spot_check_damage src/core/battle_run_compare.py:1560-1600). Metrics the record shape cannot answer are printed 'n/a' with a reason, never zeroed (NOT_DERIVABLE :124-135). The contract's §6 table (specs/contracts/battle-telemetry.md:302-312) is reproduced number for number: turns_to_ko 4/6, attacks_to_ko 4/6, hits 4/4=1.000 vs 4/6=0.667, whiff 0/2, damage 15/15, damage_per_turn 3.75/2.50, flee 0/0, outcome won/won. (3) Partitions read/excluded: 'PARTITIONS READ (2): battle-20261117_090000-ep001-enc001.jsonl [20261117_090000 — deepseek-v4-flash]' and 'PARTITIONS EXCLUDED (2): battle-20261117_090000-ep001-enc002.jsonl [E/why: E1: map 'Route 1' != 'Viridian Forest']' (_render_partitions src/core/battle_run_compare.py:1490-1510). Code: `git show --stat 5a4a67f` = '3 files changed, 3249 insertions(+)' touching only the three named files; `git status --porcelain -- src/core/battle_telemetry_store.py src/core/battle_telemetry.py specs/contracts/battle-telemetry.md` is empty → store unmodified. Tests green: `./venv/bin/pytest tests/test_battle_run_compare.py -q` → '39 passed in 0.59s'; full suite `./venv/bin/pytest -x --tb=short -q` → '4778 passed, 14 skipped in 229.44s (0:03:49)' with no FAILED lines; `./venv/bin/ruff check` on the three files → 'All checks passed!'; LSP diagnostics count 0. [resolution 0.10; src/core/battle_run_compare.py, scripts/compare_battle_runs.py, tests/test_battle_run_compare.py]

items.criterion: The CLI is reachable and runnable end-to-end from the repo entrypoint (scripts/compare_battle_runs.py main()) against a real store, exiting 0 when a table is printed and 1 when nothing is comparable — not merely importable.
items.detail: `./venv/bin/python scripts/compare_battle_runs.py --store-root /tmp/btlfix/namespaces --run-a 20261117_090000 --run-b 20261117_093000 --map "Viridian Forest"` → EXIT_with_data=0 with the full table; with nonexistent run ids → EXIT_no_data=1 and the DATA_GAP_NO_BATTLE_PARTITIONS line printed. main() at scripts/compare_battle_runs.py:283-290 returns 0/1/2 and is wired to `raise SystemExit(main())` at :296-297.

items.criterion: The tool is read-only: running it leaves every store file byte-identical and it contains no write path (no write_manifest/append_encounter/remember/open-for-write).
items.detail: md5sum of every file under /tmp/btlfix identical before and after a CLI run ('STORE UNCHANGED BY TOOL RUN'). `grep -n "write_manifest|append_encounter|\.remember(|open(.*\"w\"|open(.*'w'" src/core/battle_run_compare.py scripts/compare_battle_runs.py` → no matches (exit 1). The only open() calls are read-mode: read_partition src/core/battle_run_compare.py:700 and spot_check_damage :1580.

items.criterion: The fixture-labelling requirement is enforced by default, not only when the operator remembers --note: an unlabelled run must print a provenance line that says it is unlabeled, and a non-comparable pair must print the "real paired runs: not established" gap.
items.detail: Running WITHOUT --note prints 'label: unlabeled: every number in this table comes from stored events; nothing here proves the runs were real game runs. Pass --note with the label the store actually represents (e.g. --note fixture) before quoting it.' (_NOT_DERIVABLE_NOTE scripts/compare_battle_runs.py:56-60, wired as the --note default at :176-184). A non-comparable pair additionally prints DATA_GAP_REAL_PAIRED_RUNS (src/core/battle_run_compare.py:110-114, appended in ComparisonReport.gaps :1290-1296).

items.criterion: The damage figure traced back to its raw record is verified by identity, not just by the printed number — the spot check re-reads file:line and compares the store's record_identity hash, and reports MISMATCH rather than silently passing when it disagrees.
items.detail: Clean fixture → 'matches: True ... raw record MATCH'. Tampering the raw record AFTER the report was built (stale report vs changed store) → 'matches: False ... raw record MISMATCH'. spot_check_damage compares both raw['damage']==ref.damage AND record_identity(raw)==ref.identity (src/core/battle_run_compare.py:1590-1600), and the CLI prints the verdict via DamageSpotCheck.summary :1240-1250.

items.criterion: The exclusion accounting is honest about partitions it could not select: a run with no manifest, a partition on disk but absent from the index, and a traversing manifest path are each named as a gap and never read or counted.
items.detail: (a) A partition copied onto disk after the manifest was written → unindexed=('battle-20261117_090000-ep009-enc001.jsonl',), absent from selected, note 'unindexed_partitions: 1 file(s) of 20261117_090000 exist on disk but are absent from the manifest index and were NOT read' (select_run src/core/battle_run_compare.py:520-535). (b) A run with partitions but no manifest → manifest_present=False, selected=(), note 'manifest_missing: /game/battle/fx_nomanifest/manifest is absent, so §5.2 cannot select by key — none of fx_nomanifest's 1 partition file(s) was read' (:415-435). (c) A traversing manifest path → excluded with reason containing 'path traversal' (_unsafe_filename_reason :560-570; test_a_traversing_manifest_path_is_excluded_not_opened passes).

The only open() calls are read-mode: read_partition src/core/battle_run_compare.py:700 and spot_check_damage :1580.

items.criterion: The fixture-labelling requirement is enforced by default, not only when the operator remembers --note: an unlabelled run must print a provenance line that says it is unlabeled, and a non-comparable pair must print the "real paired runs: not established" gap.
items.detail: Running WITHOUT --note prints 'label: unlabeled: every number in this table comes from stored events; nothing here proves the runs were real game runs. Pass --note with the label the store actually represents (e.g. --note fixture) before quoting it.' (_NOT_DERIVABLE_NOTE scripts/compare_battle_runs.py:56-60, wired as the --note default at :176-184). A non-comparable pair additionally prints DATA_GAP_REAL_PAIRED_RUNS (src/core/battle_run_compare.py:110-114, appended in ComparisonReport.gaps :1290-1296).

items.criterion: The damage figure traced back to its raw record is verified by identity, not just by the printed number — the spot check re-reads file:line and compares the store's record_identity hash, and reports MISMATCH rather than silently passing when it disagrees.
items.detail: Clean fixture → 'matches: True ... raw record MATCH'. Tampering the raw record AFTER the report was built (stale report vs changed store) → 'matches: False ... raw record MISMATCH'. spot_check_damage compares both raw['damage']==ref.damage AND record_identity(raw)==ref.identity (src/core/battle_run_compare.py:1590-1600), and the CLI prints the verdict via DamageSpotCheck.summary :1240-1250.

items.criterion: The exclusion accounting is honest about partitions it could not select: a run with no manifest, a partition on disk but absent from the index, and a traversing manifest path are each named as a gap and never read or counted.

Pass --note with the label the store actually represents (e.g. --note fixture)' (_NOT_DERIVABLE_NOTE scripts/compare_battle_runs.py:56-60); a non-comparable pair also prints DATA_GAP_REAL_PAIRED_RUNS ('real paired runs: not established by this report ... a table built over fixture events must be labelled as a fixture'). (3) Partitions read/excluded: 'PARTITIONS READ (2): battle-20261117_090000-ep001-enc001.jsonl [20261117_090000 — deepseek-v4-flash]' and 'PARTITIONS EXCLUDED (2): battle-20261117_090000-ep001-enc002.jsonl [E/why: E1: map 'Route 1' != 'Viridian Forest']' (_render_partitions src/core/battle_run_compare.py:1490-1510). [resolution 0.10; src/core/battle_run_compare.py, scripts/compare_battle_runs.py, tests/test_battle_run_compare.py]
  ✓ The CLI is reachable and runnable end-to-end from the repo entrypoint (scripts/compare_battle_runs.py main()) against a real store, exiting 0 when a table is printed and 1 when nothing is comparable — not merely importable.: `./venv/bin/python scripts/compare_battle_runs.py --store-root /tmp/btlfix/namespaces --run-a 20261117_090000 --run-b 20261117_093000 --map "Viridian Forest"` → EXIT_with_data=0 with the full table; with nonexistent run ids → EXIT_no_data=1 and the DATA_GAP_NO_BATTLE_PARTITIONS line printed. main() at scripts/compare_battle_runs.py:283-290 returns 0/1/2 and is wired to `raise SystemExit(main())` at :296-297.
  ✓ The tool is read-only: running it leaves every store file byte-identical and it contains no write path (no write_manifest/append_encounter/remember/open-for-write).: md5sum of every file under /tmp/btlfix identical before and after a CLI run ('STORE UNCHANGED BY TOOL RUN'). `grep -n "write_manifest|append_encounter|\.remember(|open(.*\"w\"|open(.*'w'" src/core/battle_run_compare.py scripts/compare_battle_runs.py` → no matches (exit 1). The only open() calls are read-mode: read_partition src/core/battle_run_compare.py:700 and spot_check_damage :1580.
  ✓ The fixture-labelling requirement is enforced by default, not only when the operator remembers --note: an unlabelled run must print a provenance line that says it is unlabeled, and a non-comparable pair must print the "real paired runs: not established" gap.: Running WITHOUT --note prints 'label: unlabeled: every number in this table comes from stored events; nothing here proves the runs were real game runs. Pass --note with the label the store actually represents (e.g. --note fixture) before quoting it.' (_NOT_DERIVABLE_NOTE scripts/compare_battle_runs.py:56-60, wired as the --note default at :176-184). A non-comparable pair additionally prints DATA_GAP_REAL_PAIRED_RUNS (src/core/battle_run_compare.py:110-114, appended in ComparisonReport.gaps :1290-1296).
  ✓ The damage figure traced back to its raw record is verified by identity, not just by the printed number — the spot check re-reads file:line and compares the store's record_identity hash, and reports MISMATCH rather than silently passing when it disagrees.: Clean fixture → 'matches: True ... raw record MATCH'. Tampering the raw record AFTER the report was built (stale report vs changed store) → 'matches: False ... raw record MISMATCH'. spot_check_damage compares both raw['damage']==ref.damage AND record_identity(raw)==ref.identity (src/core/battle_run_compare.py:1590-1600), and the CLI prints the verdict via DamageSpotCheck.summary :1240-1250.
  ✓ The exclusion accounting is honest about partitions it could not select: a run with no manifest, a partition on disk but absent from the index, and a traversing manifest path are each named as a gap and never read or counted.: (a) A partition copied onto disk after the manifest was written → unindexed=('battle-20261117_090000-ep009-enc001.jsonl',), absent from selected, note 'unindexed_partitions: 1 file(s) of 20261117_090000 exist on disk but are absent from the manifest index and were NOT read' (select_run src/core/battle_run_compare.py:520-535). (b) A run with partitions but no manifest → manifest_present=False, selected=(), note 'manifest_missing: /game/battle/fx_nomanifest/manifest is absent, so §5.2 cannot select by key — none of fx_nomanifest's 1 partition file(s) was read' (:415-435). (c) A traversing manifest path → excluded with reason containing 'path traversal' (_unsafe_filename_reason :560-570; test_a_traversing_manifest_path_is_excluded_not_opened passes).
The three new files deliver a working, read-only cross-model comparison: the CLI reproduces the contract's §6 table number for number with both models named, traces a damage figure back to its raw file:line by record identity, and reports every partition read and excluded with the excluding key — with the store untouched and the full suite green (4778 passed, 14 skipped).
